name: Foam Roller Shin Roll
steps: Kneel on all fours with a foam roller placed horizontally beneath the fleshy outer front of one shin.
Support your weight evenly through your hands and your opposite foot or knee planted on the floor.
Angle your shin slightly outward to stay off the bone, then roll smoothly back and forth between your ankle and just below your knee.
Continue rolling steadily for the target duration before switching legs.
tips: Roll strictly along the muscular outer side of the shin rather than pressing directly onto the hard shinbone.
Control pressure with your hands and opposite leg so the release stays tolerable and steady.
